verdict.rationale: Deepgram's first-party docs list official SDKs for Python, JS, Go, .NET and Java. Its live-streaming guide is written around building with those SDKs, which directly delivers the story. missing for 10: documentation of SDK feature coverage/parity across APIs (e.g., Voice Agent, Audio Intelligence), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the official SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Python SDK ... JS SDK ... Go SDK ... .NET SDK ... Java SDK
